text: Tick ~3969: sawing the fallen rafter raised 'Haul out the debris' from 15 left to 17 left. The status line explains it ('three pieces to haul out instead of one'), but the counter going up feels like regress; the rafter is also not a checklist line of its own. Sawing kept progress after releasing the button (18% -> 23% shown after release, resumed to 76/99/done). Total ~16 game s of sawing.

Walls: scrubbed logs turn warm dark brown, grimy logs stay pale grey; distinguishable up close, from a step back, and with the lantern lit (contrast a bit lower under the warm lantern). But 'Scrub the walls' is slow: each reach-sized patch adds ~1% of wallsClean (~2 checklist %) for ~2 s of scrubbing, plus repositioning since reach is short and 'Too far to reach' triggers often while strafing along a wall. 13% -> 26% took ticks 5600-9980 (~146 game s, ~60 s of it actual scrubbing). Extrapolated: ~10+ game minutes of strafe-and-scrub to reach 100%.

Lit chimney stones (lantern on, scrubbed) are pale cream; the checklist text in the top-left (white with thin dark outline) is hard to read against them, e.g. 'Scrub the walls (26%)'. Also the held tool/lantern sprite covers the '8 Matches' label of the toolbar. Chimney: 0% -> 47% in ~700 ticks (~23 game s), 'Clean here. Move on.' appears quickly, but the arrow keys at low fps often do not move the view so it is hard to find the next sooty patch.
